title: Hanoi on a Shoestring: Phở, Plastic Stools, and Egg Coffee
description: Four days in Hanoi for under $100 all-in, sleeping in the Old Quarter and eating exclusively at places with furniture designed for kindergarteners. The phở breakfast rule, the egg coffee cafe hidden behind a silk shop on Hàng Gai, and how to cross an eight-lane roundabout armed with nothing but faith. Train street optional, but go early.
